body.message: Please, I need my belongings. I'm asking you not to open the door for me, even though my things, passport, and all my documents are inside. If you can't wait until I get the money, I want to vacate the apartment today and take my belongings. There's 2000 rupees available; you can take them. Please open the door politely because you have no right to lock it while all my things are inside.
